title: Transmission Line
text: Model transmission line, {Interpolation method} sets Interpolation method used to calculate values at the modeling frequencies; {Model type} sets the transmission line model Delay-based, {Transmission delay} sets the delay in transmission line, {Characteristic impedance} sets the impedance of transmission line, {Resistance per unit length}, {Number of segments}, {Parameterization} sets the type of parameters to model segments in transmission line By characterisitc impedance, {Capacitance per unit length}, {Conductance per unit length}, {Inductance per unit length}, {Outer radius}, {Inner radius}, {Conductor width} sets the physical width of conductor, {Slot width} sets the physical width of slot, {Conductor backed} sets the infinite bottom conductor, {Structure} sets the type of microstrip transmission line, {Strip Width} sets the width of microstrip transmission line, {Strip thickness} sets the physical thickness of conductor, {Strip Height} sets the strip height of microstrip transmission line, {Wire radius} sets the radius of conducting wires of two-wire transmission line, {Wire separation} sets the physical distance between conducting wires of two-wire transmission line, {Plate width} sets the width of parallel-plate transmission line, {Plate separation} sets the thickness of dielectric separating plates, {Phase velocity (m/s)} sets the propagation velocity of a uniform plane wave on transmission, {Loss (dB/m)} sets the reduction in strength of signal as it travels over transmission, {Frequency} sets the modeling frequencies 1e9, {Conductivity of conductor}, {Dielectric Thickness} sets the thickness of dielectric on which conductor resides, {Relative permeability of dielectric}, {Relative permittivity of dielectric}, {Loss tangent of dielectric}, {Line length} sets the physical length of transmission line, {Stub mode} sets the type of stub Not, {Termination of stub} sets the type of termination, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Modeling Options} sets the options to model S-parameters Frequency, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} sets the calculate impulse response duration, {Impulse response duration} sets the manually specify impulse response duration, {Fitting options}, {Relative error desired (dB)} sets the relative error acceptable in rational fit and {Rational fitting results} sets the values of rationalfit calculations. Values come from the instance.
